days.summary: Paul tells believers to put away lying and speak truth with their neighbours, because we are members of one another. Like parts of a body, communities depend on honest communication. Speak truth with love to those around you today.

days.title: Words that build up
days.summary: Paul tells us to let no rotten words come out of our mouths, only words that build others up and give grace to those who hear. Our words can be gifts of grace. Before you speak today, ask whether your words will build up.

days.title: Working heartily for the Lord
days.summary: Paul urged workers to do whatever they do heartily, as to the Lord and not to people. Working for God turns every task into worship and frees us from needing human approval. Do your work wholeheartedly for Him today.

days.title: Faithful in little things
days.summary: Jesus taught that those who are faithful in the least are faithful in much, and those who are unjust in little are unjust in much. Integrity is built in small, everyday choices. Be faithful in the little things today.

days.title: An example to others
days.summary: Paul told young Timothy not to let anyone look down on his youth but to be an example in word, conduct, love, spirit, faith, and purity. Influence comes through character, not age or title. Choose one area today in which to set a godly example.

days.title: Fleeing and following
days.summary: Paul told Timothy to flee youthful lusts and follow righteousness, faith, love, and peace with others who call on the Lord. Holy living involves both running from wrong and pursuing right, with good companions. Decide today what to flee and what to pursue.

days.title: Walking in the light
days.summary: John promises that if we walk in the light, we have fellowship with one another and the blood of Jesus cleanses us from all sin. Walking in the light means living openly before God, not being perfect. Hide nothing from God today and receive His cleansing.

days.title: Integrity at home
days.summary: David pledged to walk with a perfect heart within his own house before he spoke of ruling a nation. Home is where integrity is most tested and most important. End this month by committing to sincere integrity at home.

days.title: Merciful and gracious
days.summary: When God passed before Moses, He proclaimed Himself merciful, gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth. This self-description came right after Israel's great sin. Begin this month resting in God's own words about who He is.

days.title: I AM THAT I AM
days.summary: At the burning bush, God revealed His name as I AM THAT I AM. He is self-existent, depending on nothing, without beginning or end. Lean on the great I AM in whatever you face today.

days.title: The God who does not change
days.summary: God told His careless people that because He does not change, they were not consumed. Their survival depended on His unchanging faithfulness, not theirs. Rest today in a God whose love and promises never change.

days.title: God cannot lie
days.summary: When a king tried to get Balaam to curse Israel, Balaam explained that God is not a man who lies or changes His mind. Every promise God makes, He keeps. Trust today that what God has spoken, He will do.

days.title: He is the Rock
days.summary: In his final song, Moses described God as the Rock whose work is perfect and whose ways are all just and true. In a shifting world, God is completely stable and right. Rest your full weight on the Rock today.

days.title: Holy, holy, holy
days.summary: Isaiah saw seraphim crying holy, holy, holy around God's throne, and he was humbled by his own sinfulness. God then cleansed him with a live coal. Reflect on God's holiness today, and receive His cleansing grace.

days.title: The God who never tires
days.summary: Isaiah reminded weary exiles that the everlasting God never faints or grows weary, and His understanding is beyond searching. God never tires of caring for us. Rest today in a God whose strength and wisdom never run out.

days.title: Thoughts higher than ours
days.summary: God declared that His thoughts and ways are not like ours, especially in His abundant willingness to forgive. We cannot fully understand Him, and we are not the measure of what He should do. Trust Him today even when His ways surprise you.

days.title: Ways higher than ours
days.summary: God declared that as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are His ways and thoughts higher than ours. This vast gap is good news, because His mercy and plans are greater than ours. Look up today and trust His higher ways.

days.title: Nothing too hard for God
days.summary: While imprisoned in a besieged city, Jeremiah obeyed God's strange command and prayed that nothing is too hard for the God who made heaven and earth. God's power in creation proves He can handle any situation. Bring your impossible situation to Him today.

days.title: Everlasting love
days.summary: God told His people He loved them with an everlasting love and drew them with lovingkindness. His love is not based on our performance; it stretches from eternity to eternity. Let this truth sink into your heart today.

days.title: God is everywhere
days.summary: David asked where he could go from God's presence and concluded there is nowhere beyond His reach. For those who belong to God, His presence everywhere is a deep comfort. Wherever you are today, remember that God is there.

days.title: Fearfully and wonderfully made
days.summary: David praised God because he was fearfully and wonderfully made, one of God's marvellous works. Every person is a careful, intentional creation of a loving God. Thank God today for how He made you, and see others as His works too.

days.title: He counts the stars
days.summary: Psalm 147 declares that God counts the stars and calls each one by name. The God of vast power is also the God who personally cares for broken hearts. If He knows every star by name, He certainly knows yours.

days.title: He heals the brokenhearted
days.summary: Psalm 147 declares that God heals the broken in heart and binds up their wounds. He sees hidden pain and tends to it with patient, personal care. If your heart is broken today, bring it to Him.

days.title: A Father's compassion
days.summary: Psalm 103 says that as a father has compassion on his children, so the Lord has compassion on those who fear Him. He knows our weakness and remembers we are dust. Let Him show you His fatherly compassion today.

days.title: From everlasting to everlasting
days.summary: Moses declared that before the mountains or the earth were formed, from everlasting to everlasting, God is God. Our lives are short, but they are held by an eternal God. Rest today in the One who was before all things.

days.title: Plans that stand for ever
days.summary: Psalm 33 contrasts failing human plans with God's counsel, which stands forever. God's purposes come from His heart and cannot be overturned. When your own plans fall apart, trust His plans today.

days.title: The God who sees
days.summary: When Hagar fled into the wilderness, alone and mistreated, God found her and she named Him the God who sees. In a world where she was invisible, God noticed her. If you feel unseen today, remember that God sees you.

days.title: The Lord will provide
days.summary: On Mount Moriah, God provided a ram in place of Isaac, and Abraham named the place Jehovah-jireh, the Lord will provide. God sees our needs and provides in ways we cannot plan. Trust Him today to provide what you need.

days.title: The Lord who heals
days.summary: At Marah, God made bitter water sweet and revealed Himself as the Lord who heals. He heals bodies, hearts, and broken lives, and His nature as Healer never changes. Bring your bitter places to Him today.

days.title: The Lord is peace
days.summary: When Gideon was terrified after seeing the angel of the Lord, God spoke peace to him, and Gideon built an altar called Jehovah-shalom, the Lord is peace. God is not only the giver of peace but peace itself. Receive His peace today if fear has you hiding.

days.title: God is love
days.summary: John declares that God is love, not just that He loves, but that love is His very nature. Those who truly know Him will grow in love for others. Let the truth that God is love sink in, and let His love flow through you today.

days.title: God is light
days.summary: John declares that God is light, with no darkness at all. He is entirely pure, true, and good, with no hidden agenda. Thank God today for His perfect goodness, and step into His light.

days.title: None holy like the Lord
days.summary: After God answered her prayer for a son, Hannah sang that there is none holy like the Lord and no rock like our God. Trials often reveal God's character more clearly than comfort. Praise God today for who He is; there is none like Him.

days.title: The God of creation
days.summary: When God answered Job, He asked where Job was when He laid the foundations of the earth. Job received no full explanation, but he gained a fresh vision of God. Look at creation today and let it remind you of His greatness.

days.title: All things from Him and for Him
days.summary: Paul declares that all things are of God, through God, and to God, and to Him be glory forever. Everything begins, continues, and finds its purpose in Him, including our lives. Let this truth reshape your perspective today.

days.title: The Father of lights
days.summary: James teaches that every good and perfect gift comes from the Father of lights, who never changes. Unlike shifting sunlight and shadows, God's goodness is constant. Trace the good things in your life back to Him today and thank Him.

days.title: The same yesterday, today and for ever
days.summary: Hebrews declares that Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever. His love, power, and promises never change. When everything else feels uncertain, hold on to the unchanging Christ today.

days.title: Good to all
days.summary: David declares that the Lord is good to all and His tender mercies are over all His works. His goodness touches every part of creation. End this month thanking God for His goodness to all.

days.title: A place prepared for you
days.summary: Jesus told His troubled disciples that His Father's house has many dwelling places and that He was going to prepare a place for them. He was honest about hard things, and He would have told them if heaven were not real. Rest today in the assurance of a place prepared for you.

days.title: I will come again
days.summary: Jesus promised that after preparing a place, He would come again and receive His followers so that they could be with Him. The heart of heaven is being with Jesus forever. Let this hope lift your heart today.

days.title: Everlasting life
days.summary: John 3:16 holds the gospel in one sentence: God loved the world, gave His Son, and offers everlasting life to whoever believes. Everlasting life begins now in relationship with God and continues forever. Believe today, or give thanks for this gift.

days.title: Held in His hand
days.summary: Jesus promised His sheep eternal life and said no one could pluck them out of His hand. Our security depends on how tightly He holds us, not how tightly we hold on. Rest today in the strong hand of the Good Shepherd.

days.title: Glory yet to be revealed
days.summary: Paul calculated that present sufferings are not worth comparing with the glory that will be revealed in us. Suffering is real, but the coming glory is far greater. Weigh your trials against eternity today.

days.title: Nothing can separate us
days.summary: Paul concludes Romans 8 by declaring that nothing in all creation can separate believers from God's love, which is found in Christ. This love is anchored in Christ, not in our performance. Let this unbreakable love be your anchor today.

days.title: Eye hath not seen
days.summary: Paul writes that no eye has seen, no ear heard, and no heart imagined what God has prepared for those who love Him. His plans exceed our best dreams. Let this verse expand your view of the future today.

days.title: Death has lost its sting
days.summary: Paul taunts death, asking where its sting and victory are. Because Christ has dealt with sin, death has lost its power to destroy believers. Take comfort and courage today in Christ's victory over the grave.

days.title: A house not made with hands
days.summary: Paul compares our bodies to temporary tents and promises a permanent house from God, eternal in the heavens. He speaks not with uncertainty but with confidence. Take heart today that your true home is eternal.

days.title: The things that are eternal
days.summary: Paul kept going by looking not at what is seen, which is temporary, but at what is unseen, which is eternal. Where we focus shapes how we feel. Lift your gaze today from passing troubles to eternal realities.

days.title: To live is Christ
days.summary: Writing from prison, Paul declared that to live is Christ and to die is gain. When Christ is our life, death becomes gain and life gains purpose. Ask yourself today what fills your blank, and let Christ be your life.

days.title: Citizens of heaven
days.summary: Paul reminded the Philippians, proud of their Roman citizenship, that believers are citizens of heaven, eagerly awaiting their Saviour. Our true allegiance shapes how we live on earth. Live today as a citizen of heaven.

days.title: Appearing with Him in glory
days.summary: Paul wrote that when Christ, who is our life, appears, we will appear with Him in glory. Much of who we are in Christ is hidden now but will one day be revealed. Remember today that your true glory is hidden with Christ.

days.title: Ever with the Lord
days.summary: Paul comforted grieving believers by explaining that the dead in Christ will rise and be reunited with the living, and they will ever be with the Lord. Death separates believers only for a time. Hold on to the promise of reunion today.

days.title: Comfort for one another
days.summary: Paul told the Thessalonians to comfort one another with the truths about Christ's return and the resurrection. These promises are meant to be shared, especially in times of grief. Reach out to someone who is grieving today and share this hope.

days.title: The blessed hope
days.summary: Paul describes Christ's glorious appearing as the blessed hope that shapes how we live now. Expecting His return motivates holiness and gives perspective on present troubles. Let the blessed hope shape how you live today.

days.title: A living hope
days.summary: Peter praises God, who in His abundant mercy has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus. Our hope is alive because Christ is alive. Hold on to that living hope today.

days.title: An inheritance kept for you
days.summary: Peter describes an inheritance that is incorruptible, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for believers. Unlike earthly inheritances, it can never be lost or spoiled. Remember today that your true inheritance is safe with God.

days.title: We shall be like Him
days.summary: John writes that we are already God's children, and when Christ appears, we shall be like Him, for we shall see Him as He is. Our transformation will one day be complete. Take heart today if you feel frustrated by slow growth.

days.title: A better country
days.summary: Hebrews says the faithful of old desired a better, heavenly country, and God was not ashamed to be called their God. Our longing for more is a sign that we were made for heaven. Let that longing point you to the city God has prepared.

days.title: A city to come
days.summary: Hebrews reminds believers that here we have no lasting city, but we seek one to come. Nothing on earth is permanent, but God's city will never fall. Hold earthly things loosely today and seek the city to come.

days.title: Dwelling in the house of the Lord
days.summary: David declared that goodness and mercy would follow him all his days, and he would dwell in the Lord's house forever. God's goodness pursues us through every season and brings us home. Look back today at how it has followed you, and look ahead with confidence.

days.title: Satisfied in His likeness
days.summary: While others found satisfaction in earthly things, David looked forward to beholding God's face and being satisfied with His likeness. Only God can satisfy completely. Let your hope rest today on seeing His face.

days.title: Shining as the stars
days.summary: Daniel's vision promises that the wise will shine like the sky and those who turn many to righteousness will shine like the stars forever. Pointing others to God is eternal work. Look for someone you can point toward God today.

days.title: Every tear wiped away
days.summary: Isaiah prophesied that God will swallow up death in victory and wipe away tears from every face. This promise is certain, because the Lord has spoken it. Hold on today to the day when God Himself will dry every tear.

days.title: No more sorrow
days.summary: John saw a new heaven and earth where God wipes away all tears, and there is no more death, sorrow, crying, or pain. The former things will pass away. If you are hurting today, hold on to the hope of a world without pain.

days.title: All things made new
days.summary: From the throne, God declared, Behold, I make all things new, and told John to write it because these words are true. God restores what is broken and will one day renew all creation. Bring Him what is broken in your life today.

days.title: No night there
days.summary: John describes the city of God where there is no night, because the Lord God Himself gives light, and His people reign forever. All darkness, fear, and sorrow will be gone. Hold on today to the promise of a day without night.

days.title: Treasures in heaven
days.summary: Jesus urged His followers to lay up treasures in heaven, where nothing can corrupt or steal them. Every act of love done for Christ is an investment that lasts. Take stock today of where you are investing your life.

days.title: A crown of righteousness
days.summary: Near death, Paul declared that a crown of righteousness was laid up for him, and for all who love Christ's appearing. Faithfulness is never forgotten by the righteous Judge. Remember today that a crown awaits all who long for His return.

days.title: Grace to the end
days.summary: The Bible's final verse is a blessing of grace from the Lord Jesus Christ on all His people. Scripture begins, continues, and ends with God's undeserved favour. Close this year under His grace and step into the new one wrapped in it.
